# Synthetic TIFF test fixtures

Apache-2.0. Generated by ../../make-tiff-fixtures.mjs from numeric patterns; no third-party images. The three slice fixtures contain known translations for registration. Probe fixtures contain fixed samples for byte-order, WhiteIsZero, RGB16, prediction and compression checks. The minimal LZW writer emits clear codes and literal runs. These files are test assets and are not copied into the public site.
